parameters.name: CallbackConfig
parameters.description: The webhook address. This is a JSON array. When an event occurs, the live service sends an HTTP POST request to this address. The request body contains the event details.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The primary streaming domain.

><notice>

Currently, only domain names in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions are supported.

</notice>

parameters.name: InputStreamList
parameters.description:
The list of input streams. This is a JSON array.

For more information, see **InputStreamConfig** below.

parameters.name: LayoutId
parameters.description:
The layout ID. Valid values:

- **MixStreamLayout-1-1**
- **MixStreamLayout-2-1**
- **MixStreamLayout-2-2**
- **MixStreamLayout-2-3**
- **MixStreamLayout-3-1**
- **MixStreamLayout-3-2**
- **MixStreamLayout-4-1**
- **USERDEFINED** (If you do not use a preset layout, set this parameter to **USERDEFINED**.)

> For more information, see [Preset stream mix layouts](~~199359~~).

parameters.name: OutputConfig
parameters.description:
The output configuration. This is a JSON string.

For more information, see **OutputConfig** below.
